attribution: Photograph by Cristian-Mihail Miehs, 31 August 2012, released to public domain. Brâncuși's Coloana Infinitului (Endless Column) at Târgu Jiu, Gorj County, Romania. Sculpture inaugurated 27 October 1938. Romania has freedom of panorama for permanent works installed in public spaces. The sculpture itself remains under copyright until 2027 (Brâncuși d. 1957, EU life+70); the photograph is hosted under the photographer's PD release combined with Romanian FOP and a de-minimis claim (the column appears within a wider park scene). Via Wikimedia Commons.
subject: Constantin Brâncuși's Coloana Infinitului (Endless Column), Târgu Jiu, Romania — the 29.3-metre sculpture of stacked rhomboidal modules, completed 1938, that Steichen had earlier installed (in a smaller version) in his garden at Voulangis, France. The Târgu Jiu monument is the public, monumental form of the same sculptural idea Steichen owned and photographed in his own French garden in the 1920s.
